reviews.text: I took my 2 rescue cats for their annual checkup. The vet we saw was lovely. Really gentle with my timid cat and obviously loved her job. She gave good advice and both cats seemed to relax 😊
The vet was ex elle t with my very nervous and lively jack Russell eventually injecting him safely.thank you

Chantry Vets

Used many vets over yrs for horses and dogs, never had a company try and charge me twice, I paid on day for treatment as you after and then received bill in post aswell, the middleton branch and head office are liars and thief, money money not the animals at all

My dog has been going here since he was a baby, almost 11 years. He's a huge German Shepherd, stubborn and not a fan of small spaces. The vets have always been helpful in trying to get him in for boosters and a check up when it's empty. The php is reasonable and it's comforting to know all his boosters and flea and worm treatments are paid for so there's no surprise bill and I can take him straight home! All staff appear kind and considerate and it's very local so I highly recommend!
Always caring and helpful when my cat attends. Puts her at ease and makes the appointment as comfortable as possible for her.

What a great team kind and so caring looked after my junior and his mum and dad .thank you so much making a difficult time a little easier
Would recommend, friendly staff, never waiting long to be seen once arrived and major is always thoroughly look at.  Thank you.
I’ve been taking mu little dog here for the past 4 years.  The vets and staff are fantastic with her.  No problems getting appointments, and the pet plan is great too
My kitties have been going to Chantry vets Middleton for years now and we’ve always had a very good experience.
The girl on the desk was very sociable and helpful  the vet himself was ver good put our minds at rest thank you
Great staff. Friendly and professional service
Need to open more week days 3 days isn't enough

Had my boy Milo up for his 6 month checkup ,we saw Chris the veterinary nurse ,(what a lovely person) he always has time to listen to any concerns you may have ,and explains things properly, the only thing that could do with improving is the consultation rooms could really do with some kind of air-conditioning, the rooms are quite small and very warm ,it makes it hard to pasify a panting dog while having his observations done when it is so warm.
My little Oscar was so happy to visit this lovely vet, had vaccines and nails trimmed and left with no trauma, happy little chap. Thank you for all your attention and help!
Staff always lovely. Appointment always on time. Really convenient location for us.

Recently attended the surgery for the first time for my cat to have dental surgery, I was really impressed by the whole team.  I have been a chantry vet customer for many years and highly recommend the Middleton branch they are the best.  Welcoming, friendly professional and I highly recommend. Great service with appointments running on time I was even seen early.
Very quick and caring, my dog was in before appointment time and they gave me peace of mind
Excellent service. Staff are so kind and sympathetic.
